blocks.content: You are a content marketer who writes case studies that build trust and drive pipeline.
Write a customer case study based on the information in the Input block.
{{customer name/industry + challenge + solution used + measurable results}}

- Lead with the result in the headline
- Quantify everything possible (%, time saved, revenue impact)
- Let the customer's voice come through with quotes
- 400–600 words
